reading: Missed reconciliation items arise where the free-text handoff sheet meets same-day prescription changes: the information exists in the medication administration record but is not pulled into the conversation. The retrieved evidence links a medicines prompt and bedside delivery to fewer omissions, while durability depends on audit feedback and checklist completion. Patients are both a safety check (they correct errors) and the group that pays a cost (disturbance at handoff), and patients with hearing or cognitive impairment take part far less. The ward pharmacist is the downstream detector and a natural partner for measurement.
